template: Open the existing quotation {{v1}} (reference {{v1}}, for customer '{{v3}}') in this Odoo 17 Sales app — you can navigate to Sales > Orders > Quotations and search for {{v1}}, or open {{v5}} . reportTemplate.summary: Opened existing quotation {{v1}} (sale.order id={{v2}}, URL /web#cids=1&menu_id=194&action=316&model=sale.order&view_type=form&id={{v2}}) and clicked "Add a product". In the new line's product autocomplete I selected a genuine dropdown option different from Acoustic Bloc Screens — initially "[FURN_1118] Corner Desk Left Sit"/"Customizable Desk" did not commit a price, so I re-selected via the keyboard path choosing "[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors", which committed unit price 140.00. I set that line's Quantity to 2.00 and saved (Save button then Ctrl+S); the save reported "no visible change" each time, so I verified persistence by navigating away and reloading the record URL — the second line was still present, confirming it is stored server-side. Two order lines are on the form: "[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens" qty 3.00 @ 295.00 (£885.00, 20% tax) and "[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors" qty 2.00 @ 140.00 (£280.00, 20% tax). CAVEAT: I did not get to re-read the totals section after adding the second line, so the new Untaxed Amount is NOT verified — arithmetically it should be £1,165.00 (885.00 + 280.00), but I never observed that figure on screen; the last totalled value I actually read was £885.00 before line 2 was added.

values.untaxed_amount: NOT VERIFIED after adding line 2 (expected ~£ 1,165.00; last observed value before line 2 was £ 885.00)
